00.name: Sweat
00.text: Well I think we know from now on never to take directions from Sour again.

01.name: Sour
01.text: Ah come on. Stop being such a winy baby, we found our way eventually.

02.name: Sweat
02.text: We would have found our way faster if we went right instead.

03.name: Lumberjack
03.text: Come on stop arguing. Your doing my head in.

06.name: Narrator
06.text: The edge of the forest comes into sight as your group continues to march forward.
